premises.text: Nematodes are ubiquitous hard-to-eliminate pests that infect or eat crops
premises.evidence_span: They are everywhere, and they infect everything, and if they don't infect it, they will eat it. They are very hard to get rid of

premises.text: Farmers need pest control while markets and rules push eco-friendly alternatives over conventional pesticides
premises.evidence_span: This leads to farmers demanding eco-friendly alternatives

premises.text: Discovered pheromone behaviors, including dispersal, provide a way to control nematodes
premises.evidence_span: when you add the pheromones, they disperse and they look for new food

premises.text: Ferrocote applied to seeds before planting protects vulnerable roots from parasitic nematodes
premises.evidence_span: It effectively tells them to go find something else to eat

premises.text: Nemastim turns beneficial nematodes into stronger insect biocontrol organisms
premises.evidence_span: we make them into better biocontrols. Nemastim makes beneficial nematodes up to 200% more effective

domains.name: Pheromone seed treatment and biocontrol enhancers

value.text: Eco-friendly products that control nematodes so farmers grow more food
value.evidence_span: eco-friendly products control nematodes, so farmers can grow more food

causal_links.evidence_span: We've taken this technology and used it to create our first two products
farmers lose roughly 12% of their crops
help us bring eco-friendly pest control
